d:
379 I'm rescuing another John K Pe-ta thing from MTL hell. Again, I want to be very clear, I'm only doing this because I was given a decensored Raw.

MTL is a death sentence nearly 99% of the time. I commission these with my own hard earned cash, and I can't justify commissioning a retranslation for an MTL when I could instead get something brand new released. Just doubling down on this, the ONLY reason I considered this was because someone gave me the raws for free, and I wanted to return that good deed to the community.
